== Description ==

[[Jack Douglass]] (main subject, ponytail, glasses, goatee, black Star Wars graphic tee, name tag “Jack”) and [[Paul Coggins]] (background right, beard, black cap, dark plaid shirt under a black jacket, name tag, looking at a phone) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
